item.title: Ask HN: What is some software that you wish existed?
item.summary: What is a type of software, app, or tool that you wish someone would create because it doesn’t currently exist—or because the existing options aren’t good enough? It could also be some kind of hardware which is doable with current technology, but doesn't exist. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49259602 Points: 1 # Comments: 3
